questions.statement: Which letter comes right after M in the English alphabet?
questions.context: Clase de ingles de tercer grado en la que los estudiantes repiten el abecedario en voz alta.

options.feedback: L comes before M in the alphabet, because the order goes L, M and then N.
In the English alphabet the letter N comes right after M.
O comes two letters after M, because N comes between them.
K is three positions before M in the alphabet, so it does not follow it.

questions.explanation: Memorizar el abecedario en orden facilita deletrear y escribir. La pregunta comprueba la posicion exacta de una letra concreta, y para responder basta con reciting el tramo K, L, M, N y observar que la letra buscada va inmediatamente despues.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: How do you spell the letter "R" in English?
questions.context: Ejercicio de deletreo oral durante la entrega de tarjetas de presentacion.

options.feedback: Arre uses a double r and would be the Spanish name of the letter R, not the English one.
Ere is the Spanish name of the letter R and is not the English spelling.
In English the letter R is spelled are, with a vowel first, and that is the spelling used to spell it out.
That spelling mixes the initial A with a final r and does not match the letter R of the English alphabet.

questions.explanation: Las letras del abecedario ingles tienen nombres propios que no siempre coinciden con los del espanol. La R inglesa se llama are, mientras que en espanol se escribe erre, y esa diferencia de ortografia es la que este ejercicio comprueba.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.context: Actividad de escritura del nombre de un compañero en una tarjeta.

options.feedback: That word is written with a V instead of an S, and school is spelled with sc.
That form drops the second s in school and gives scuel, which is not an English word.
school is spelled with sh at the start, oo in the middle and l at the end.
That form changes the u into an o and gives esquol, which is not the correct spelling.

questions.explanation: El deletreo por sonido funciona bien con palabras simples, pero algunas combinaciones inglesas no siguen la regla esperada y deben aprenderse como unidades. La palabra school pertenece a ese grupo, igual que she o science, porque sh y sc se pronuncian igual pero se escriben distinto.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read: "Sofia writes her name as S-O-F-I-A." How many letters does she spell?
questions.context: Ejercicio de deletreo de su propio nombre completo en la mesa de orientacion.

options.feedback: Four would be the total if one letter were missing from the sequence S O F I A.
The sequence S O F I A has five letters, which are S, O, F, I and A.
Six letters would be one more than the hyphens in the sentence show.
Three counts only the vowels, and the question asks for every letter of the name.

questions.explanation: Contar los elementos de una secuencia separada por guiones es una habilidad de lectura muy util para el deletreo. Cada guion marca un limite, de modo que el numero de guiones mas uno da la cantidad total de letras.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Which word begins with the letter "T"?
questions.context: Ejercicio de escritura de las palabras del abecedario en la libreta del curso.

options.feedback: cat starts with the letter C, not with T.
book starts with the letter B, not with T.
fish starts with the letter F, not with T.
table starts with T, which is the letter the question asks for.

questions.explanation: Asociar cada letra del abecedario con una palabra que empiece por ella construye un repertorio de vocabulario y reinforce la escritura. Esa estrategia es la que permite escribir palabras nuevas sin tener que consultar el diccionario para cada una.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: Read the note: "My birthday is on the fifth of March." Which letter does the month start with?
questions.context: Lectura de una tarjeta escrita por un compañero del curso.

options.feedback: F is the initial of fifth, the word that spells the day.
The month is March, and that word starts with the letter M.
B is the initial of birthday, which is the noun in the subject of the sentence.
T is the initial of the, an article, and does not name any month.

questions.explanation: Leer de izquierda a derecha y localizar la palabra que responde a la pregunta evita confundir palabras similares. El enunciado pide el inicio del mes, y como el mes se escribe March, la inicial buscada es M y no la de otra palabra de la frase.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: The letters C, A, R spell a vehicle. What is the word?
questions.context: Ejercicio de ordenamiento de letras para formar palabras de la unidad.

options.feedback: arc uses the three letters, but that word does not name any vehicle.
The letters C, A and R in order spell car, which means vehicle in English.
cra is not an English word and does not name any means of transport.
rac does not exist as a word either and does not name a vehicle.

questions.explanation: Reordenar letras es una forma de comprobar que se reconoce una palabra y no solo su traducion. Las tres letras C, A y R pueden formar varias combinaciones, y el dato del enunciado sobre el significado es lo que decide que el orden correcto es car.
questions.subject: ingles

questions.statement: The teacher writes the days of the week on the board. Which word is a day of the week?
questions.context: Actividad final de la unidad en la que cada estudiante escribe su nombre y el de un amigo.

options.feedback: table is a piece of furniture and not the name of any day of the week.
window is a window and does not appear in the list of days.
banana is a fruit and has nothing to do with the names of the days.
Tuesday is the name of the day after Monday and is part of the week.

questions.explanation: Reconocer los nombres de los dias es parte del deletreo porque son palabras que el estudiante escribe desde muy temprano. Todos empiezan por mayuscula en ingles y se ordenan de Monday a Sunday, una secuencia que conviene aprender como bloque.
questions.subject: ingles
